verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so asking about a serverless or edge function runtime is a fair question. However, the evidence documents no edge or serverless functions product, and nothing says unmodified Node.js and npm packages run there. Docker support, long-running services and the TypeScript workflow SDK are adjacent capabilities, not edge/serverless functions with a full Node runtime. A community comment about trying Render for a Node API is only a stated intention, not evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run unmodified Node.js code and npm packages in edge/serverless functions instead of a restricted runtime subset
